say:4:1321420002:1.text: It's alright. It's not a serious wound. You don't need to worry about me.
say:4:1321420002:1.source_cn: 行了，又不是什么很严重的伤。小小年纪，不要总是替我操心。

say:5:1321420003:1.text: You all didn't need to help me, but thanks anyway.
say:5:1321420003:1.source_cn: 其实你们不用帮我的……不过，还是谢谢你们。

say:7:1321420004:1.text: That's right. We went to help you pick flowers, and then you disappeared on us!
say:7:1321420004:1.source_cn: 就是说啊。我们去帮你采花，你却到处乱跑！

say:10:1321420005:1.text: Rather than thanking us, tell us why you came here to fight the undead alone.
say:10:1321420005:1.source_cn: 比起感谢，我们还是更想知道你为什么要独自跑到古战场来，...

say:11:1321420008:1.text: Not long ago, I was a member of the ducal guard. Thanks to the guard captain, I even became the leader of a small patrol team.
say:11:1321420008:1.source_cn: 不久之前，我还是公国卫队的卫兵。鉴于卫队长的赏识，我甚...

say:12:1321420009:1.text: A while ago, when I was on patrol, I encountered an undead squatting on a tombstone. He was hunched over, wearing a helmet with his face covered. There was a sword stuck through his throat... My team members were terrified.
say:12:1321420009:1.source_cn: 前阵子，我带人巡逻的时候遇到了一个蹲在墓碑上的活死人。...

say:13:1321420010:1.text: But he didn't hurt anyone like the other undead. Instead, he helped some lost children find their way home. So, we let him go.
say:13:1321420010:1.source_cn: 出人意料的是，他没有像其他活死人那样伤害人类，反而在为...

say:16:1321420011:1.text: You must be talking about Igor! We know him!
say:16:1321420011:1.source_cn: 咦？你说的这个人好像是伊戈尔！我们认识他！

say:19:1321420012:1.text: Yes, Igor is not a bad person. He just likes to play with children. Thank you for not hurting him.
say:19:1321420012:1.source_cn: 是啊。伊戈尔不是坏人，他只是比较喜欢和小孩子玩。谢谢你...

say:20:1321420013:1.text: Good, I'm glad my intuition wasn't wrong,
say:20:1321420013:1.source_cn: 哈……我就知道我的判断不会出错。

say:21:1321420014:1.text: However, my team members were unhappy with the decision.
say:21:1321420014:1.source_cn: 不过……哈，我的队员们对我放走活死人这件事很不满。

say:22:1321420015:1.text: They think I was too scared to fight, that I let the undead go because I was a coward...
say:22:1321420015:1.source_cn: 他们认为我不敢和活死人战斗，认为我是因为懦弱才放走了活...

say:23:1321420016:1.text: Later, I was punished and expelled from the guard.
say:23:1321420016:1.source_cn: ……再后来，我就收到了处分，被开除出卫队。

say:24:1321420017:1.text: So, you want to fight the undead here to prove that you're not a coward.
say:24:1321420017:1.source_cn: 所以，你想要击败这些活死人，以此来证明自己不是懦夫？

say:25:1321420018:1.text:
That's right...
I'm not doing this only for myself but for Peter as well.
say:25:1321420018:1.source_cn: ……没错。\n既是为了我自己，也是为了彼得。

say:27:1321420019:1.text: After I was expelled from the guard, everyone thought I was a coward. A lot of people made fun of Peter as well. Other children in town refused to play with him.
say:27:1321420019:1.source_cn: 我被开除之后，有很多人觉得我是懦夫，所以连带着彼得……...

say:28:1321420020:1.text: All of this is my fault...

say:30:1321420022:1.text: You don't understand, Peter. When our parents were dying, they told me over and over to take care of you.
say:30:1321420022:1.source_cn: 好了，彼得，你还不明白。爸妈临终时，嘱咐过无数遍，让我...

say:32:1321420024:1.text: Oh, there's a wound on your back, and it looks serious! It must be treated right away!
say:32:1321420024:1.source_cn: 哎呀，你背上怎么还有一道伤！而且看起来好严重……必须马...

say:33:1321420025:1.text: Where's your healing potion? Don't you always carry it with you?
say:33:1321420025:1.source_cn: 哥哥，你的治疗药剂呢？你平时不是都会随身带着吗？赶快拿...

say:34:1321420026:1.text: They're useless for wounds like this...
say:34:1321420026:1.source_cn: 没什么用的，那些药恐怕止不住这么严重的伤……
